Node role
↑/↓ choose · Enter next. Each card says what the node does,
how much traffic to expect and what the operator risks.

> Relay and mailbox for friends
  Carries session traffic between peers and keeps offline
  messages. The internet exit is off.
  traffic: moderate, grows with the number of friends ·
  risk: minimal, content is not readable

  Free exit
  Besides relay and mailbox, it lets other people's
  traffic out to the internet for free. An own domain and
  a cover site are needed.
  traffic: high, capped by the bandwidth limit · risk: the
  operator answers for the traffic of others

  Home entry RU/IR
  An entry inside the country for mobile networks with
  allow-lists: relay and invitations, the exit is off.
  Details: docs/domestic-entry.md.
  traffic: moderate, own people only · risk: the addresses
  and traffic volume of people are visible; data requests
  are possible

  Private exit by invitation
  An exit without a public card: reachable only through an
  invitation link. Invitations and terms are the invite
  commands.
  traffic: as many as invited · risk: the operator answers
  for the traffic of the invited

  Own set
  Roles are ticked by hand: relay, mailbox, dht-server,
  exit. The other settings follow the common presets.
  traffic: depends on the roles · risk: depends on the
  roles

  Paid exit
  Paid exit — after 0.3.0: payments and vouchers are not
  ready yet.

↑/↓ choose · Enter next · Esc cancels
